title: Template Adapter Configuration
description: Configuration schema for dspy-template-adapter integration in DSPx. Provides exact prompt fidelity with user-defined message templates, provider-aware output format selection, and optimizer compatibility.

messages.description: Message templates for the adapter. Each message defines a role and content template.

parse_mode.description: Output parsing mode. 'auto' selects based on provider capabilities (json for json_mode providers, xml for Claude, json otherwise). 'chat' falls back to DSPy's ChatAdapter parsing.

custom_parse_fn.description: Import path to custom parse function with signature: (signature, completion) -> dict. Example: 'myapp.parsing.custom_json_parser'

register_helpers.description: Map of helper name -> import path for custom template functions. These helpers can be used in message templates.

TemplateMessage.description: A single message template. Supports standard roles plus special directives for demos and history injection.

role.description: Message role. 'demos' injects few-shot demonstrations. 'history' injects conversation history.

content.description: Template content with placeholders like {instruction}, {inputs()}, {outputs()}, {demos()}. Required except for demos/history directives.

user.description: Custom template for demo user messages (alias for user_template). Only used when role='demos'.

assistant.description: Custom template for demo assistant messages (alias for assistant_template). Only used when role='demos'.

examples.description: The signature instruction text (optimizable by MIPRO/COPRO)
